title: Demonologist vs anointed Undying Loyalty / Eternal Guardian
problem: Demonologist's rule runs first and discards what those perks should keep.
notes: Fix: H: reorder 2026-10-26 hook batch B2: left needs-hook. Demonologist runs first and discards minions / buffs the anointed perks should keep; the fix is a reorder of the death-handling blocks, not a call-site change. Not built. Round-3 F2 2026-10-26: built. bc_HandleDeath: the L91 Demonologist compare reports 'no' when Undying Loyalty (231) or Eternal Guardian (387) applies, so the chain reaches UL / EG; UL's IsBuff test is false when EG also applies (buffs kept); EG's IsMinion test is false for demon minions 56-62 for a Demonologist (demons kept). Also fixes UL + EG without Demonologist (UL used to win and drop buffs). In-game test: Demonologist + anointed Undying Loyalty: a dying creature keeps all its minions (demons included), loses buffs. Demonologist + Eternal Guardian: keeps buffs and its demon minions, loses other minions. UL + EG (any spec): keeps buffs and minions. Demonologist alone: unchanged (only demon minions kept).

release_notes.effect: Demonologist with anointed Undying Loyalty or Eternal Guardian (perks)
release_notes.intended: Undying Loyalty keeps minions through death and Eternal Guardian keeps buffs through death.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, Demonologist's own death rule threw these away, so the anointed perks did nothing for a Demonologist.
release_notes.fix: Now minions (Undying Loyalty) and buffs (Eternal Guardian) persist through death for a Demonologist too; with both, both are kept. Demons are kept as before.
